description:
Paul Lafferty Ltd Auctioneers is delighted to offer New to The Market  1 Springfield Castlerea Co. Roscommon 

Three Bedroom Semi Detached Residence 

Accommodation consists of large entrance hallway, living room, kitchen/dinning room at w.c There are Three Bedrooms on the first floor with Master Ensuite and family bathroom 

This property has been vacant for in excess of two years and may be eligible for the vacant homes grant 

The property  has advantage of off street car parking  and lawn area to the front, along side entrance and lawn garden area to the rear with garden shed. 

It is conveniently located within walking distance of Castlerea Town centre and all local amenities. 

Ideal investment property with potential from strong rental income or suit an owner occupier. 

To arrange a viewing please contact sole selling agents Paul Lafferty Ltd
